title: Consecutive Flop Years
scenario: Identify studios that have released games with an average user_score < 5.0 for 3 or more consecutive release_years.
tableSchema: games (game_id INT, release_year INT), developers (game_id INT, studio_name VARCHAR), ratings (game_id INT, user_score NUMERIC)
hint: Create groups using year minus rank, then count the size of each group.
correctQuery: SELECT studio_name FROM (SELECT studio_name, grp, COUNT(*) as streak FROM (SELECT studio_name, release_year, (release_year::INT - DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY studio_name ORDER BY release_year)) as grp FROM (SELECT d.studio_name, g.release_year FROM games g JOIN developers d ON g.game_id = d.game_id JOIN ratings r ON g.game_id = r.game_id GROUP BY d.studio_name, g.release_year HAVING AVG(r.user_score) < 5.0) t) t2 GROUP BY studio_name, grp) t3 WHERE streak >= 3;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, release_year INT); CREATE TABLE developers (game_id INT, studio_name VARCHAR); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, user_score NUMERIC);
